I've been saying this for a while. That is that investment is dead. Diversify with different currencies ranging from USD to Euro to BTC to other altcoins. Dump what you see is going down and you know will continue going into the others.

Why is investment dead? Because most government tied currencies are fauceted at the moment and getting access to that faucet to invest in your business does take a bit of work but likely doesn't include the average joe in the process. Basically the biggest banks get free money at what ever flow rate they want. The smaller banks get nearly free money (the free money plus a small fee from the bigger bank). The businesses get free money with a larger free. I wish in economics we talked about flux more. It's a common topic in physics and is useful for understanding systems. Anyway the the inward flux of the business is fully satiatiated by the outward flux of the fed so there is no flux from you (that is flow of money).

BTC has other problems that make it difficult to lend. One is enforcement. The other is that without a fed people are tighter with it. Another is that anything that looks looks fractional reserve banking in btc is almost always a scam and scares people off right away. Lending as an institution is completely non-existent in BTC and will likely stay that way.

Another death to investment. Stocks universally don't pay dividends and can still IPO without offering dividends and investors have finally caught onto the fact that these are just volatile value stores rather than investments and that they make a good outlet for trying to make money with analysis but investments they are not.

So the best you can do is a value store. Even none of those are perfect and the more you attempt to make money the more likely what you pick is further from perfect. Just get with the game, diversify, try to identify losses and mitigate them. That's the game now. If billionaires can't make money out there you can't either. There is no reason for billionaires or you to be involved in the loan/invest loop if it can be sustained from another source of flux.
